aviation_incidents.headline: NTSB尋獲11月1日佛州Learjet 60墜機案駕駛艙語音記錄器 目前在華盛頓接受評估
aviation_incidents.summary: NTSB已尋獲11月1日在佛羅里達州Greenacres附近墜毀的Learjet 60駕駛艙語音記錄器；機上9人全數罹難，該機由Aurora Aviation以Upper Jets名義營運。記錄器目前在NTSB位於華盛頓特區的實驗室接受評估，天候狀況與空中解體相關證據仍在調查中。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: NTSB Recovers Cockpit Voice Recorder from Learjet 60 That Crashed in Florida on November 1, Now Under Evaluation in Washington
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The NTSB recovered the cockpit voice recorder from a Learjet 60 that crashed near Greenacres, Florida, on November 1, killing all nine people on board. Aurora Aviation operated the aircraft as Upper Jets. The recorder is being evaluated at the NTSB Vehicle Recorders Laboratory in Washington, D.C.; investigators are examining weather conditions and evidence of an in-flight breakup.

new_information: The NTSB says it has recovered the cockpit voice recorder from the Learjet 60.
The Learjet 60 crashed near Greenacres, Florida, on 1 November, killing all nine people on board.
The Learjet was operated by Aurora Aviation, doing business as Upper Jets.
The NTSB says cockpit voice recorders record radio transmissions and cockpit sounds, including pilot voices and engine noises.
The CVR is being evaluated in the NTSB Vehicle Recorders Laboratory in Washington, D.C.
The NTSB said weather conditions and evidence of an in-flight breakup are being investigated.

aviation_incidents.headline: 聯合航空UA-168機組回報機艙異味後轉降雅典 飛機安全降落
aviation_incidents.summary: 聯合航空波音787-9執行UA-168航班，由特拉維夫飛往紐華克，機組回報機艙異味後轉降雅典，約40分鐘後安全降落03R跑道；航空公司表示已調派替代飛機。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: United UA-168 Diverts to Athens After Crew Reports Cabin Odour and Lands Safely
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A United Boeing 787-9 operating UA-168 from Tel Aviv to Newark diverted to Athens after the crew reported an unusual cabin odour and landed safely on runway 03R about 40 minutes later. The airline said it was dispatching a replacement aircraft.

aviation_incidents.headline: 愛爾蘭航空EI-107折返都柏林 飛機安全降落 監聽頻率聽眾轉述機組稱天氣雷達兩度故障
aviation_incidents.summary: 愛爾蘭航空A330-300執行EI-107航班，由都柏林飛往紐約甘迺迪，折返後於起飛約1小時安全降落。監聽頻率的聽眾轉述機組稱天氣雷達兩度故障，爬升時曾聽到巨響並聞到異味。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Aer Lingus EI-107 Returns Safely to Dublin; Listener Relays Crew Report of Two Weather-Radar Failures
aviation_incidents.summary_en: An Aer Lingus A330-300 operating EI-107 from Dublin to New York JFK returned to Dublin and landed safely about one hour after departure. A listener monitoring the frequency relayed that the crew said the weather radar had failed twice; the listener also reported that the crew heard a loud noise and noticed an odour during climb.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣棒球隊搭乘星宇航空JX800赴日 AIRSORAYAMA GOLD藝術機執飛
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺灣代表隊球員與教練搭乘星宇航空JX800赴日，航班由AIRSORAYAMA GOLD藝術機執飛。星宇航空準備應援毛巾與茶包，並安排曾代表臺灣隊出賽、現任空服組員張甄芸在機艙門口為球員加油。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Baseball Team Flies to Japan on STARLUX JX800 Aboard AIRSORAYAMA GOLD Aircraft
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's baseball players and coaches flew to Japan on STARLUX flight JX800 aboard its AIRSORAYAMA GOLD aircraft. STARLUX prepared cheering towels and tea bags and arranged for a cabin crew member who had represented Taiwan in baseball to greet the players at the cabin door.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍徵詢廷德爾基地6座F-35A機棚反無人機網方案 尚未承諾採購
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍於2026年11月6日發布徵求來源公告，考慮為佛羅里達州廷德爾基地6座F-35A停機棚四面加裝反無人機防護網，要求能攔截約9公斤以下的第1類無人機；公告僅屬市場調查，尚未承諾採購。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Air Force Seeks Anti-Drone Nets for Six Tyndall F-35A Shelters, Without Committing to Purchase
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Air Force issued a sources-sought notice on November 6, 2026, to explore enclosing six F-35A shelters at Tyndall Air Force Base in Florida with counter-drone netting. The netting must stop Group 1 drones weighing up to about nine kilograms; the notice is market research and does not commit the Air Force to a purchase.

international_aviation.headline: airBaltic與漢莎集團簽署長期濕租協議 2027年A220-300機隊將縮至36架
international_aviation.summary: airBaltic與漢莎集團簽署長期濕租協議，配合2027年將A220-300機隊縮至36架；airBaltic夏季最多提供6架含機組的A220-300為漢莎營運，冬季4架，濕租航班將與自有定期航線並行。
international_aviation.headline_en: airBaltic Signs Long-Term Lufthansa Wet-Lease Deal as A220-300 Fleet Shrinks to 36 in 2027
international_aviation.summary_en: airBaltic signed a long-term wet-lease agreement with Lufthansa Group as it prepares to reduce its A220-300 fleet to 36 in 2027. It will operate up to six aircraft with crews for Lufthansa in summer and four in winter, alongside its own scheduled network.

international_aviation.headline: 波音民航部門將裁減約2,500個職位 737 MAX與787增產步調放緩
international_aviation.summary: 波音宣布民航部門將透過非自願裁員與自然流失削減約5%人力、約2,500個職位；11月不裁員，裁員通知自12月起發出。工廠與供應鏈挑戰使737 MAX及787增產步調放緩。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing to Cut About 2,500 Jobs in Its Commercial Airplanes Division as 737 MAX and 787 Production Growth Slows
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing said it will reduce its Commercial Airplanes workforce by about 5%, or roughly 2,500 jobs, through involuntary layoffs and natural attrition. No layoffs are planned in November, with notices beginning in December; factory and supply-chain challenges have slowed production increases for the 737 MAX and 787.

international_aviation.headline: 達美航空首架A350-1000完成全套塗裝 業界預期2027年6月投入商業營運
international_aviation.summary: 達美首架空中巴士A350-1000已在土魯斯廠完成全套塗裝，製造商序號841；交付前仍須安裝發動機、完成地面檢查與飛行測試。達美官方資料列2027年初開始交付，業界報導則預期6月投入商業營運；航空公司已訂購20架。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta's First A350-1000 Completes Full Livery Ahead of Reported June 2027 Commercial Debut
international_aviation.summary_en: Delta's first Airbus A350-1000 has completed its full livery at Airbus's Toulouse facility. The aircraft is manufacturer serial number 841 and still needs engine installation, ground checks and flight testing before delivery. Delta's materials list deliveries beginning in early 2027, while industry reports point to a June commercial debut; the airline has ordered 20 aircraft.
